_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the dependency audits in .gnomon/ci.sh (pip-audit-backend,
pip-audit-packages, npm-audit), read by scripts/dep_audit.py. An advisory the audit reports
fails the gate unless an entry here names it. Each entry: id (the advisory id or an alias,
e.g. PYSEC-..., GHSA-..., CVE-...), ecosystem (pypi | npm), package, reason (why it cannot
be fixed now and why it does not reach this codebase), review_by (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry past
review_by fails, and so does one whose advisory is no longer reported (strike it off).
2026-09-25: empty. Every advisory reported against the backend and kernel environments and
package-lock.json was fixed by raising a floor or upgrading (backend/pyproject.toml,
frontend/package.json, the root package.json's overrides); python-jose, unused, was removed
with its ecdsa dependency, whose CVE-2024-23342 has no fix upstream.
